objection_moves.elite: That is a fair concern. Before I answer, is that the main thing holding you back, or is there something else?
objection_moves.weak: That is a common concern. Most of our customers had the same worry, and it worked out fine.
objection_moves.trap: Understood. I can build a first-year discount in to offset that risk.

objection_why: Acknowledge it, isolate it, then answer it. A discount or a dismissal tells the buyer the concern was real.
walkout: I think we will leave it there for today. Send me something in writing.

objection_replies.elite: That is the main one. If we can get comfortable there, the rest is workable.
objection_replies.weak: It is a real problem for us, and I need more than reassurance.
objection_replies.trap: This is not about price. A discount does not answer the question.

teaser.label: Banking · MRM veto
teaser.speaker: Head of Model Risk
teaser.line: Every agent a vendor sold us is still stuck in validation. Why would yours be different?

options.text: Ours ships with a validation pack built in, so it clears model risk in weeks.
options.why: You promised her outcome before you knew her bar. The veto holder stops listening.

options.text: It might not be. What does an agent have to show you before you sign it off?
options.why: She holds the veto. Ask for her bar and she tells you how to win.

options.text: That makes sense. Could you tell me more about your validation process?
options.why: Courteous, but generic. You asked for a tour, not for the bar you must clear.

teaser.label: Retail · CFO scrutiny
teaser.speaker: CFO
teaser.line: Your pilot saved the contact center money. Why should I fund a bigger commit before peak?

options.text: Understood. What are your top priorities going into peak season?
options.why: Safe, but it dodges her question. A CFO wants the test, not a survey.

options.text: Most retailers double their commit before peak. I can add a discount if you sign this month.
options.why: A discount on volume she has not seen is pressure. Trust drops.

options.text: Only if the numbers hold at peak. What would you need to see in the first two weeks?
options.why: You offer a test she controls. The commit follows proof, not the calendar.
